addWebsite.deployStep: 3. Deploy or Push to your server:

model.title: Hybrid Detection Engine & Model Artifacts
model.description: ThreatSentry pairs deterministic protocol rules and HTTP response differential analysis with a character-level TF-IDF classifier trained on the OWASP Core Rule Set and CSIC 2010 benign traffic.
model.playgroundDesc: Test the active classifier with real SQLi, XSS, or benign payloads to observe real-time probability distributions.
model.classNormalDesc: Benign application traffic, standard web queries, clean alphanumeric parameters, and everyday URL parameters.
model.classSqliDesc: Structured query injection variations including union-based probes, boolean differentials, comment truncations, and stacked queries.
model.classXssDesc: Cross-site scripting vector patterns, event handler injections, unencoded tag breaks, and javascript pseudoprotocol indicators.
model.testPerformanceDesc: Evaluated on strictly isolated test samples with zero structural group overlap to ensure zero data leakage.
model.decisionDesc: In compliance with safety boundaries, ML classification operates as a supportive signal rather than an autonomous decision maker. The decision matrix below outlines how confidence levels are derived:
model.coreSafetyDesc: Machine learning predictions alone are mathematically barred from producing a CONFIRMED vulnerability. Confirmation requires deterministic proof such as exposed database error structures or unencoded reflection contexts.

landing.heroDesc: ThreatSentry combines automated web vulnerability scanning, scope-aware crawling and Machine Learning intrusion detection to identify SQL Injection, XSS, Path Traversal, security misconfigurations and suspicious web payloads.
landing.coverageTitle: Security analysis across your web attack surface.
landing.coverageDesc: ThreatSentry combines deterministic security checks, active verification and machine-learning analysis in a single workflow.
landing.mlTitle: Rules find patterns. ML adds another signal.
landing.safetyTitle: Security testing should start with authorization.

marketing.ctaTitle: Know your attack surface before someone else does.
